_doc: Monsieur's subscriptions (declared by him). Source of truth for walter_router/subscriptions.py: what each plan includes, how its usage meter is read, when its routes stop being used, and what the plan is worth at API list prices (published third-party measurements, dated and sourced). Readings go to models.subscription_usage.

subscriptions.models_note: Every model of the live Codex account catalogue (models.offers, provider codex, access subscription).

meter.note: Hermes agent/account_usage.py (chatgpt.com/backend-api usage endpoint, read-only). Plus has a weekly window only (no 5-hour window) since 2026-09-29.

policy.note: Sub-tasks routed by walter_run stop using the subscription at reserve_percent of any window, so the rest stays for the Hermes conversation itself (GPT-6.1 Sol on Codex); at exhausted_percent the subscription route goes last everywhere.

plan_values.source: SemiAnalysis, Anthropic Subscriptions Offer 5x+ More Value Than OpenAI (2026-10-05)
InventiveHQ, How Much Codex Does a ChatGPT Plan Buy? (2026-10)

subscriptions.execution_note: Used by Monsieur in Claude Code (desktop app sessions on the VM). Not callable by Hermes: no Claude login on the VM, and Anthropic reserves subscription credentials for its own apps.

excluded.claude-fable-5-1: Fable is not included in Pro: pay-as-you-go usage credits at API price.

meter.note: Estimated from the Claude Code transcripts on the VM (~/.claude/projects): weighted units = input + cache writes + 5 x output, cache reads ~free (SemiAnalysis: no meter movement after 500M cache-read tokens; Wokey: output 4-7x input). Rolling 7 days, the weekly limit binds before the 5-hour one. Sessions run outside the VM are not seen.
meter.capacity_basis: prior from SemiAnalysis Pro / Opus 5.5 (1,178 $/month at 0.399 $/M blended = 2.95 B tokens/month: 76.8 M cache writes + 11.8 M input + 8.9 M output = 133 M units/month = 30.7 M/week). Replace with `walter-router subscriptions calibrate anthropic-pro <weekly %>` read on claude.ai > Settings > Usage.
